selection_rule: Outcome-independent complete two-sided book; latest capture per contract, then midpoint closest to 0.5 for point thresholds.
limitations: Fourteen still-upcoming Week 9 games have fresh captured references from each provider. Jacksonville–Baltimore had started and was not recaptured as pregame. The original DraftKings normalizer covered 13; one additional current capture was recovered by the owner using exact documented schedule evidence.
Additional DraftKings observations cover 11 of 14 Week 10 games. Other missing observations remain explicit.
Current observations are not final pregame prices or proof of executable fills.
Kalshi quote time remains unknown where only observation time is supported.
Thresholds and quoted lines are not expected final margins or totals.
